TASK 05

Firebase Logging, Automation & Data Export

Historical IoT monitoring, manual and automatic appliance control, data logging and CSV export.

01

Overview

The Smart Home dashboard includes a historical-data section, a data-log table and a CSV download function.

The system also provides manual and automatic operating modes and an adjustable LDR threshold.

02

Concepts

Data Logging

IoT measurements can be stored for later review.

Historical Data

Previously recorded sensor values can be represented graphically.

Automation

The dashboard provides manual and automatic operating modes.

CSV Export

Logged information can be prepared for download as CSV data.

05

Wiring / Setup

The hardware setup consists of the ESP32, DHT11, LDR, relay and bulb described in the Smart Home documentation.

06

Implementation

The dashboard provides a Historical Data section with a graph area and a Data Log table.

The data table is structured to display timestamp, temperature, humidity, LDR, bulb state and operating mode.

07

Configuration

  • Manual Mode available.
  • Automatic Mode available.
  • LDR threshold can be configured.
  • Historical data section included.
  • Data log table included.
  • CSV download control included.
08

Evidence

Historical data, automation and logging dashboard evidence.
09

Challenges & Fixes

IoT logging requires coordination between sensor readings, database storage, dashboard display and downloadable data.

10

Reflection

This task demonstrates how an IoT dashboard can go beyond simple ON/OFF control by including historical monitoring, automation modes and structured data export.
